sheets.offer_facts:
Speed to Lead is a done-for-you inbound lead response system. It contacts every new inbound lead in under 60 seconds, across email, text message and phone, follows up automatically until the lead responds, and hands the live conversation to the client's own salesperson when someone is ready to talk. It works on leads from web forms, email enquiries, paid ads and directories. The system is trained on how the client's team already talks, so replies sound like their salespeople rather than an autoresponder.

Commercial model: We build and install the full working system for free. The client runs it on their own live leads and then decides whether to keep it. There is no fixed trial length. If they keep it there is an implementation fee plus a monthly fee, both scoped on the call. Never state any fee, number or range in an email reply.

One variant of the cold email offered to install the system free and run it for 14 days, with no payment if it does not improve their lead to conversation rate. If a prospect refers to those terms, they stand. Otherwise there is no fixed trial length.

Cleared proof point (the client is never named): a services business in NYC was losing qualified leads to slow response times. The system was set up in under 7 days and helped them close an additional 3 new clients in the first 2 weeks.

Boundaries: do not promise a setup timeline for this prospect, the under 7 days figure is a past result and not a commitment. Never name any client. Do not state or imply a price. Do not promise a specific number of leads, clients or revenue.
sheets.high_level_answer: We install a system that answers every new inbound lead in under 60 seconds and keeps following up until they respond, then routes the live conversation to your team. We build it for free so you can test it on your own leads first.
